scope: Pinned Flutter dart:ui compiler target and restricted macOS ARM64 AOT/bytecode cold-process engine experiment
verified: VM and Flutter have explicit separate condition environments, SDK imports, dynamic contracts and baseline identities. Cross-target patches and changed UI SDK source fragments fail closed.
Real Flutter CFE confirms all 21 environment values. Original-source and generated Kernel preserve Color, Offset and UI-typed callback signatures.

A matching Release ARM64 host Flutter engine library was built from pinned patched sources (2918 Ninja steps), preserving existing dynamic runtime tools. The committed builder then reused it with no work; this is not a second clean build.

Four real AOT engine processes compare original baseline/candidate with generated baseline/bytecode update. Both sides match exactly; unchanged main/blender remain AOT, only origin/shade are installed.
Host probe enforces AOT engine mode, a bounded completion check, task ordering, engine shutdown and unchanged baseline/engine bytes.
Space gate, fresh-output protection, read-only planning and incorrect-engine-hash rejection were executed independently; no forbidden output or evidence overwrite occurred.

The final ordinary run used unchanged frozen compiler/test inputs. Host builder/verifier/C++ probe were added afterward and separately compiled and verified against the real engine; final hashes match those execution records.
failures_and_fixes: An early CompilerTarget draft used duplicate const-map keys and a shadowed target variable; corrected before real target compilation.
A directed test initially omitted the hashlib import; corrected and reran both Flutter tests successfully.

Kernel inspection initially used the wrong ConstantExpression field and a generic RecursiveVisitor API; fixed to the pinned Kernel API. The first verify.sh stopped at static analysis with exit 3; preserved its log and fully reran after correction.
AOT CFE removes const fields and folds environment values into main; inspect the actual Kernel string-list values instead of missing fields.

Running a Flutter snapshot in standalone dartaotruntime exited 253 because dart:_builtin was absent. Built and used the actual Flutter AOT embedder instead; the failed standalone evidence remains under output/flutter-target-inspection.

cache_cleanup.scope: Inactive reference host ANGLE/Vulkan .o/.a caches only; current dynamic output, sources, SDKs, binaries and historical QA artifacts preserved

limitations: Only the fixed dart:ui Color/Offset/callback fixture was executed. No Widget rendering or full framework lowering acceptance.
The minimal foundation source graph now passes dart:ui but still rejects unlinked dart:io with exit 2 and no baseline output.
No mobile engine rebuild, Android/iOS device cold start, signatures, rollback or performance acceptance in this round.
Historical native suites were not rerun; the host UI execution report does not promote M1 or production gates.
